WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall_average_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(mtr.rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(1.0 * mtr.track_count) AS average_number_of_tracks,
  AVG(mtr.rate - o.overall_average_rate) AS average_margin_above_overall_average
FROM media_type_rates AS mtr
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE mtr.rate > o.overall_average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Treat each media type equally when calculating the overall simple average of rates, with each rate being the arithmetic mean of Bytes/Milliseconds across its tracks; tracks without Bytes or with zero milliseconds are excluded because their rate is undefined.
